thread:
Alex (Support): Hey team — customer reports streaming cutouts after token rotation. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can someone share a minimal curl to reproduce the auth handshake + SSE so they can run locally? They see 200 -> stall -> 401 after ~45s.

Maya (Eng): Can you paste the curl they used? Need full headers, proxy info, and whether they used cookies vs bearer.

Alex (Support): They sent this (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  --compressed --no-buffer
```
Response shows 200 then stalls then 401. Trace header they captured: X-Request-ID: 01XYZA (they included server-side trace id too).

Tony (SRE): Ask them to try with --http2 and keepalive tweaks. I usually ask for this exact variant:
```bash
curl -v "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_REDACTED>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: 01XYZA" \
  --http2 --no-buffer --keepalive-time 30
```
Collect the full `curl -v` output and the first ~200 bytes of each response chunk.

Jordan (DevEx): Also include User-Agent parity — `User-Agent: acme-app/1.2.3` — and X-Forwarded-For if they're behind a proxy. Tell the customer to redact actual tokens and replace with `<TOKEN_REDACTED>` in the paste.

Maya (Eng): If 401 consistently appears ~45s after connect, suspect connection reuse + token refresh. Please collect:
- full `curl -v` dump
- the X-Request-ID and backend trace id (we can map it in logs)
- simple client-side timings (first byte, time-to-close)
- if browser: a HAR of the handshake

Alex (Support): I'll ask them to run both the curl above and this quick TLS check and attach outputs: `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -tlsextdebug` — capture the first two packets if they can.

debug-bot: debug bundle created: bundle_789f (internal link).
Link: https://internal/debug/bundle_789f

Tony (SRE): When they post, ensure they redact secrets but keep X-Request-ID and our internal trace ids. We'll grep logs for `req_0a1b2c3d` and correlate with bundle_789f.

Maya (Eng): Final sanity-check curl snippet to paste for customer (replace placeholders):
```bash
curl -v "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?session=live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_REDACTED>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "User-Agent: acme-app/1.2.3" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: 01XYZA" \
  --http2 --no-buffer --raw
```
If this reproduces the auth cutoff, please paste `curl -v` output and also `head -c 512` of the stream stdout.

Alex (Support): Thanks — I'll follow up with the customer and paste outputs here. :thumbsup:
